dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple interconnected 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible along the dorsal-lateral ridge. These exhibit thin, high-contrast light perimeters with fuzzy, irregular edges that transition sharply into darker internal voids and a dark blue-black base substrate.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid high-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated primarily in the anterior neck region. These clusters lack internal gradients and appear as isolated punctate markings between the larger macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the cranial-dorsal flank form a distinct scalene triangle. An additional curvilinear alignment of centroids is observable following the longitudinal axis of the dorsal midline towards the posterior.
